confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of UK seaside-city price levels for July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain given July peak demand. Beer assumes a pint-size (about 568 ml) serving. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer because direct knowledge is weaker. GBP prices were converted using approximate general-knowledge rates, not a live quote. FX value taken from an RBA exchange-rates overview excerpt returned by search; the daily F11.1 table could not be opened to cross-check.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general UK south-coast seaside-city pricing: meals and drinks broadly in line with large English regional cities and below central London, with accommodation raised for summer seaside demand.
